title: Embeddings and Semantic Search
description: Turn text into vectors and search by meaning instead of keywords.
learningOutcomes: Explain what an embedding actually represents
Compute similarity between pieces of text
Build a small semantic search index

lessons.title: What Embeddings Represent
lessons.description: Vectors as a geometric encoding of meaning.
learningObjectives: Generate embeddings for a batch of text

lessons.title: Measuring Similarity
lessons.description: Cosine similarity and why it, not Euclidean distance, is the default.
learningObjectives: Rank documents by similarity to a query

lessons.title: A Minimal Vector Store
lessons.description: Build a simple in-memory semantic search index before reaching for a database.
learningObjectives: Store and query embeddings in memory
Compare a naive store to a real vector database
Decide when you actually need a vector database

lessons.title: Semantic Search Over Your Own Notes
lessons.description: Build search that finds relevant text by meaning, not exact words.
learningObjectives: Chunk and embed a real document set
Serve a top-k semantic search query
Evaluate whether results are actually relevant

assignment.title: Assignment: A Semantic FAQ Search CLI
assignment.description: Build a real tool that chunks a small support-FAQ corpus, embeds it, and serves ranked semantic search results over a query — every technique in this module working together.
learningObjectives: Chunk and embed a real multi-document corpus
Rank results by cosine similarity against a live query embedding
Evaluate whether top-k results are actually relevant, not just returned
